body_lead: Lucknow: The Uttar Pradesh govt allocated Rs 225 crore in the 2026-27 budget for its newly launched Uttar Pradesh AI Mission, announced by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath during the state's AI conclave in Jan. The mission aims to position Uttar Pradesh as a national leader in artificial intelligence adoption, particularly in healthcare, where projects worth around Rs 2,000 crore will be implemented over the next 3 years to improve disease surveillance, predictive health models and real-time data-driven policymaking.
